canon_status: Officially profiled fixed opening character; later player succession, party, route, and ending outcomes excluded.

supports: Gerard's Varennes title, Leon relationship, inheritance-magic transfer, and Seven-Hero campaign role.

comparison_cautions: Imperial inheritance and later ruler choices are source-specific game systems; no player-selected successor state is assigned to Gerard.
